13. Former Secretaries of Poreign Affairs
14. , Such other government offioals and civic
leaders as the President may designate
The Cabinet Secretariat shall serve as perma-
nent Secretariat of the Coucil and is hereby charged
with the responsibility of preparing all implementing
actions on, and the following-up of, all matters ta-
ken up by the Council, and keeping the President re-
gularly informed of all action taken thereon.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of
November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and seventy-one.
(SGD.) FORDINAND I. MARCOS
President or the Philippines
By the President:
(SOD.) ALEJAIIDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secrotary
